description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets for various languages used in research on hateful communication from 2012 to 2022, with the vertical axis labeled “Number of datasets” on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^2, and the horizontal axis labeled “Year” with integer years from 2012 to 2022. A legend in the top-left corner indicates that blue bars represent English, orange represent “All other,” green represent Arabic, red represent Bengali, purple represent Spanish, and brown represent Russian. Each year features a group of up to six bars, one for each language category, with the height of each bar indicating the count of datasets for that language in that year. In 2012, only English datasets are present, with a value of approximately 1. In 2013, again only English datasets are present, also at approximately 1. In 2014, English datasets are again present at approximately 1. In 2015, English datasets are present at approximately 1. In 2016, English datasets are present at approximately 10, while “All other” datasets are present at approximately 1. In 2017, English datasets are present at approximately 10, “All other” datasets are present at approximately 10, Arabic datasets are present at approximately 1, Bengali datasets are present at approximately 1, and Spanish datasets are present at approximately 10. In 2018, English datasets are present at approximately 10, “All other” datasets are present at approximately 10, Arabic datasets are present at approximately 10, Bengali datasets are present at approximately 1, and Spanish datasets are present at approximately 10. In 2019, English datasets are present at approximately 10, “All other” datasets are present at approximately 10, Arabic datasets are present at approximately 10, Bengali datasets are present at approximately 10, Spanish datasets are present at approximately 10, and Russian datasets are present at approximately 10. In 2020, English datasets are present at approximately 100, “All other” datasets are present at approximately 100, Arabic datasets are present at approximately 10, Bengali datasets are present at approximately 10, Spanish datasets are present at approximately 10, and Russian datasets are present at approximately 10. In 2021, English datasets are present at approximately 100, “All other” datasets are present at approximately 100, Arabic datasets are present at approximately 10, Bengali datasets are present at approximately 10, Spanish datasets are present at approximately 10, and Russian datasets are present at approximately 10. In 2022, English datasets are present at approximately 10, “All other” datasets are present at approximately 10, Arabic datasets are present at approximately 10, Bengali datasets are present at approximately 1, Spanish datasets are present at approximately 10, and Russian datasets are present at approximately 1. The bars for each year are grouped side-by-side, and the chart does not show any sorting of the bars by height or alphabetical order. The chart visually emphasizes that English datasets dominate the count throughout the period, while datasets for non-top five languages remain comparatively low.
